title: 12 Best Tel Aviv's Legendary Nightlife
description: Discover Tel Aviv's best nightlife, from pulsing clubs and speakeasy bars to vibrant live music venues. Your ultimate guide to the city that never sleeps, updated for 2026.

places.name: Kuli Alma
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Local craft beer (e.g., Malka) or their signature Gin & Tonic.

places.name: Imperial Craft Cocktail Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try one of their seasonal specials or ask for a bespoke cocktail based on your preferences.

places.name: The Block Club
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Bottled water or a simple beer to stay hydrated while dancing all night.

places.name: Port Said
places.priceRange: 40-70 ILS ($11-20) for drinks, 60-120 ILS ($17-33) for food
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Arak with grapefruit, and don't miss their famous focaccia or green beans.

places.name: Sputnik TLV
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their seasonal cocktail menu always has unique options, or a classic Negroni.

places.name: Shpagat
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Arak with grapefruit or a local Israeli wine.

places.name: Bellboy Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the 'bellboys' for their recommendation – each drink has a story and a unique presentation.

places.name: Teder.fm / Romano
places.priceRange: 40-70 ILS ($11-20) for drinks, 60-100 ILS ($17-28) for food
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A slice of their delicious pizza and a local Israeli beer (Goldstar or Maccabee).

places.name: SpeakEazy Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Aperol Spritz or one of their refreshing gin-based cocktails.

places.name: Drama
places.priceRange: 40-75 ILS ($11-21) for drinks, 60-100 ILS ($17-28) for food
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their house cocktail or a bottle of local Israeli wine.

places.name: Jimmy Who
places.priceRange: 50-80 ILS ($14-22) entry (often includes a drink) + 35-60 ILS ($10-17) per drink
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Vodka Red Bull or a shot of Arak to get the party started.

places.name: Silon
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A cheap local beer like Goldstar or Maccabee.
